Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications of 3M Convective Patient Warming System (02 nos.) 1. The equipment must be a forced air warmer - Should deliver warm air uniformly to the patient through disposable blanket. 2. It should be a microprocessor based handy and with accurate temper ature sensor system. It should be Time to reach Operating Temperatur e (Classified as 23°C ±3°C to 37°C) within 2 to 5 minutes. 3. Unit Weight should be 16 lb not more then. 4. The equipment should be USFDA approved. 5. The equipment should be pole and bed mountable. 6. Flicker-free operation is defined as Meets UL 60601-1 and IEC 60601- 1 requirements. CAN/CSA-C22.2, No. 601.1 7. It should have audible and visual alarms in case of over temperature & General Fault. 8. It should be provided with 10 Pcs of Multi Position Blankets for Adult P atient Size-198 X 61cm and weight 104g with two hose holes. 9. Operators' experience sound level Should be 50 dBA or less then. And Airflow setting Should be One speed, non-adjustable Up to 44 CFM (20. 8 L/s). 10. Operating temperatures Should be Ambient, 32° C (89.6° F), 38° C (89.6° F), 43° C (89.6° F). 11. Flicker-free operation defined as Meets IEC 60601-1; IEC/EN 60601-1- 2; UL 60601-1; CAN/CSAC22.2, No.601.1; EN 55011: EN 80601-2-35. 12. It should be Hose weight-1.51 lbs, length-75 In & diameter-2.0 In. 13. Side openings at the hose end ensure positive air flow if hose end is o

ccluded. 14. Blankets and equipment should be from the same OEM. The blankets should be provided with two re-sealable hose ports for flexibility of posi tioning. 15. It should have ISO 13485:2016 which should be either from NABCB ac credited Certifying bodies or from a member body of IAF (International Accreditation Forum). 16. The firm should be provided 20 nos. blankets (free of cost). 17. one year warranty . 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
